insights: Vertex-pancyclicity is strictly stronger than pancyclicity: every vertex on every cycle length

Woodall conditions (n≥2k+3, enough edges) should give VP up to length n-k
Walk API in Lean requires careful type handling for cycle extraction
QM-AM identity 2S+1=n²+c² gives threshold ≥ n²/4+1 for all valid k
Products of consecutive ℕ always even—key for division-free proofs
